meta.name: orchestrating-multi-agent-systems
meta.description:
Execute orchestrate multi-agent systems with handoffs, routing, and workflows across AI providers.
Use when building complex AI systems requiring agent collaboration, task delegation, or workflow coordination.
Trigger with phrases like "create multi-agent system", "orchestrate agents", or "coordinate agent workflows".

copy.tagline: 让多个AI智能体分工协作完成复杂任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要构建由多个AI智能体协同工作的系统
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate multiple AI agents to collaborate on complex tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build systems that orchestrate multiple AI agents

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按需求设计和实现多智能体系统:定义智能体角色与工具权限、设置交接规则、编排顺序/并行/条件工作流,支持跨 AI 服务商,并生成 TypeScript 代码、集成测试和路由分类器。
howto.when: 当你说“创建多智能体系统”“编排智能体”等关键词,或请求构建需要智能体协作、任务委派或工作流协调的复杂系统时触发。

say.text: 创建一个多智能体系统,包含一个协调者和两个专业代理。
say.note: 开始搭建项目,定义各代理角色和工具权限。

say.text: 用 AI SDK v5 实现代理间的 handoff,并设置超时保护。
say.note: 配置交接规则和错误处理机制。

say.text: 为我的客服场景编排一个 supervisor 模式的智能体工作流。
say.note: 按 supervisor 拓扑生成工作流代码。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude build multi-agent systems across AI providers: define roles/tool scopes, set handoffs, orchestrate workflows, and output TypeScript modules, tests, routing.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like "create multi-agent system", "orchestrate agents", or when requesting complex AI systems needing agent collaboration, delegation, or workflow coordination.

say_en.text: Create a multi-agent system with one coordinator and two specialist agents.
say_en.note: Starts a project defining agent roles and tool scopes.

say_en.text: Implement agent handoffs using AI SDK v5, with timeout guards.
say_en.note: Configures handoff rules and error handling.

say_en.text: Orchestrate a supervisor-mode workflow for customer support.
say_en.note: Generates workflow code with supervisor topology.
